title: test(cli): budget the four slowest migrate spawn files, drop one duplicate spawn and two reader children
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XDCjyZFgAsyum5wCUN8ZzVB)_

Part of #23181 (slice 23). The card stays open: 63 other `domain:server` files still read over 10 s (Acceptance notes).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`packages/cli` 里 CI 读数最慢、且没有 budget 头的 4 个 `os migrate` 集成测试文件，各加一行第 2 行 `// test-budget:` 头（450 / 170 / 110 / 80 s）；顺带去掉 object-scope 里一次与前面完全相同的 CLI spawn（改为复制那次运行的数据库），和 unmapped-columns 里两次读库用的 node 子进程（改为进程内 better-sqlite3 读）。
- **为什么改**：卡 #23181 的测试提速职责：超过 10 s 的测试文件要么提速，要么按裁决 6181973363 B 声明预算。这 4 个文件每次 spawn 都是不同的（命令、参数、夹具）三元组，地板就是真实工作，所以走 budget 头。
- **风险与回滚**：只改测试文件，不发布任何东西（cli 的 `files[]` 只有 dist、README、CHANGELOG）；每个文件的断言一条没删、没放宽；回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/object-scope.integration.test.ts`（`earnedDb` 改为复制 full-scope 运行的库）；`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/unmapped-columns.integration.test.ts`（`readState` 改为进程内读）；另外两个文件只加了头。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/migrate/object-scope.integration.test.ts` → 20/20 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The scheduled `ci.yml` runs on `main` after slice 22 put four `packages/cli` migrate integration files at the top of the `domain:server` list, with no `// test-budget:` header. Readings are the default reporter's per-file module line in the Test Core shard logs (all shards `success`) of runs `41199450735`, `41217827347`, `41237094739`, `41255489006` (its Test Core shards passed; only Test UI 5/16 failed) and `41271604267`:

| file | 0735 | 7347 | 4739 | 9006 | 4267 | header |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `data-commands.absent-database.integration.test.ts` | 346.8 | 216.4 | 264.1 | 343.2 | **355.5** | 450 |
| `object-scope.integration.test.ts` | 80.0 | 104.5 | 88.4 | 133.8 | **135.5** | 170 |
| `unmapped-columns.integration.test.ts` | 48.8 | 64.2 | 52.7 | **84.8** | 83.4 | 110 |
| `plan.telemetry-sibling.integration.test.ts` | 47.9 | **62.3** | 60.4 | 41.7 | 47.7 | 80 |

**Cause, per file.** All four share one cause: they spawn the source CLI (`node bin/run-dev.js`, already on `process.execPath` since slice 12, already under the queue-tier oclif manifest since slice 14), and each spawn boots a migration stack against a SQLite fixture. They already boot or seed their fixture once in a `beforeAll`. I counted spawns against distinct (command, flags, fixture) triples:

- `data-commands.absent-database`: two seed children and 46 CLI spawns (three #21529 commands and eleven #21552 doors, each `--json` and human on the absent database and `--json` on a booted control, plus four already-exit-0 doors). All 46 are distinct triples. About 7.5 s per spawn in CI.
- `object-scope`: one seed child and 18 CLI spawns, each on its own copy of the seeded database. **One triple repeated:** the earned-flag case ran `value-shapes --apply --yes --json` on a fresh seeded copy, the same as the family loop's full-scope `value-shapes` run. Now it copies that run's database (`copyFileSync(full.get('value-shapes').db, earnedDb)`), so 17 spawns. The full-scope run's own database is not touched; the case still asserts `verifiedBefore.verified_at` is set and unchanged after the narrowed run.
- `unmapped-columns`: one seed child, ten CLI spawns (all distinct), and two `node` children that only read the database's schema and rows before and after. Those two reads now run in process with `better-sqlite3`, the same reader `object-scope` and `plan.telemetry-sibling` already use. The before/after comparison is still byte equality of the same JSON shape.
- `plan.telemetry-sibling`: two serving boots and five CLI spawns, all distinct. Header only.

**Headers** (ruling 6181973363 letter B, class `spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture`): N = the slowest of the five CI readings × 1.25, rounded up to 10 s. All four parse with `readTestBudget` (`scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs`). The object-scope header keeps its pre-hoist CI reading.

Not changed: no assertion, case name, timeout, tier or project. No source file.

## Tests

- **A/B** (one box, one lock hold, base copied beside head as `zzbase.*`, interleaved, N=3, `--project integration --maxWorkers=1`, default reporter file line; copies deleted before the gate run):

  | file | base (s) | head (s) | change |
  |:--|:--|:--|--:|
  | `object-scope` | 90.90, 91.52, 91.72 | 84.75, 86.01, 86.57 | −6.1% (mean 91.38 → 85.78) |
  | `unmapped-columns` | 59.39, 61.15, 58.77 | 57.23, 60.48, 57.78 | −2.2% (mean 59.77 → 58.50) |

  Every run exit 0; object-scope 20/20 tests and unmapped-columns 10/10 tests on both sides, same names.
- **Header-only files**, run once on head: `data-commands.absent-database` 51/51 (248.5 s), `plan.telemetry-sibling` 2/2 (38.5 s).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`) exit 0, with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096` (the default heap OOMs in `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`).
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed (test-only).

## Acceptance notes

- **Slice 22's premise was a partial read.** Slice 22 reported no other `domain:server` file over 10 s in run `41199450735`. The whole shard logs (`gh api …/actions/jobs/ID/logs` now returns them uncapped) show 135 server files over 10 s in the five runs. 72 are inside their own header. After this slice, **63 still count** (39 in `packages/cli`, 7 `verify`, 4 `plugin-auth`, 4 `plugin-security`, 4 `runtime`, 3 `rest`, 1 `plugin-pinyin-search`, 1 `service-automation`). The slowest are `migrate/plan.boot-parity` (60.6 s), `test/dev-boot-output-order` (59.4 s) and `test/verify-author-time-stage` (53.6 s, over its 50). Full table and parser: `pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s23/` in the project files. Carrier: #23181's next slices.
- **`skip-changeset`.** Test-only. `@objectstack/cli`'s `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and its build does not emit `*.integration.test.ts` into `dist/`, so no `files[]` content changes.

## Verification

All readings on head `12e8da5e` (the only commit).

- **Derived gate families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 51 families, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe. Two first reads were container prerequisites, re-read after meeting them: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` exit 3 (no full build) → `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` (118/118 tasks) → both exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 51 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- **Hand gates:** `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the four files exit 0 (`@objectstack/cli` has no `lint` script; the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's); `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0.
- **CI** families (Test Core with the cli integration tier, lint farm, type-check lanes) are read off this PR's check-runs by the seat.
